answer: Reputation is a scarce, unforgeable resource earned by consistently passing originality checks, and the economy spends it to filter out Sybil clusters before they can compound into a majority. The practical upshot is that honesty is the only strategy that scales — a farm that tries to game the system pays for each identity it adds.. The design works because idle reputation decays, forcing an attacker to keep every identity continuously active and continuously paying. Consider a terrace as the anchor of the cost.
